name: Piracy Reworked
author: Tristan
description: The black market is pirate infrastructure - and every credit you spend there is revenue for the underworld. Your smuggling feeds a pirate war chest that finances raids and new bases; successful raids refill it, and left unchecked, piracy snowballs across the sector. Repel raids to contain it, hunt bases to roll it back - or keep fencing loot and watch the lights go out. Standalone. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
